model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of sales over a twelve-month period, from January (I) to December (XII), for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024. The horizontal axis represents the months, ordered from I to XII, and the vertical axis displays the percentage of sales, ranging from 0% to 120,000%, with a linear scale. The value axis is labeled “%” and features tick marks every 20,000%, with numerical values displayed at intervals of 20,000%. The bars are grouped by year, with blue bars representing 2022, orange bars representing 2023, and gray bars representing 2024. The 2022 bar reaches approximately 82,000% in January and decreases to approximately 78,000% in December. The 2023 bar begins at approximately 75,000% in January and rises to approximately 115,000% in December. The 2024 bar starts at approximately 80,000% in January and reaches approximately 105,000% in December. All bars are sorted in ascending order based on their height, and no bars are visually emphasized.
